jobDescription.text:
Millrace Industrial Partners is a private equity firm investing in lower-middle-market manufacturers.

You’ll lead ERP separation for carve-outs, getting each new portfolio company off its former parent’s SAP before the transition services agreement (TSA) expires. Expect travel up to 40% to portfolio company plants.

qualifications.text: SAP S/4HANA program leadership; finance and supply chain process depth.
